selection_basis: Feature provenance and coverage, NOT observed performance in this experiment; all admitted representations will be reported including negative results

not_selected.mosei_qwen: Same Qwen/WavLM as mosei_full but retains old Facet vision; avoid redundant preliminary fits
not_selected.m3ed_ftT: No pack contract found in this directory; another documented finetuned RoBERTa pack available

audit_notes: MOSEI_full has exactly the reference train/valid IDs, labels, and histories. One WavLM-invalid training row changes the audio mask; disclosed, not silently replaced.
MOSEI_full keeps reference vision masks despite the CLIP extraction receipt reporting full coverage. Current packed masks are preserved; this may underuse available CLIP rows.
MELD has split-local IDs; 675 identical ID strings across train/valid do not alone establish same underlying utterance. Do not claim verified global disjointness from these IDs.

MELD/M3ED RoBERTa feature extractors were finetuned on train and selected on valid at seed17. Repeated downstream seeds are conditional on this ONE fixed feature extractor, not independent full-pipeline finetunes.
CH-SIMS_v2 full_packed is version2 (2143 train,647 valid), not original CH-SIMS; comparisons must use the correct version and continuous-label protocol.
official_test_finalization: Not authorized in this turn; no sealed test tensor is opened
